title: Grilled Butterflied Herbed Chicken
ingredients: 3 tablespoons of your favorite herbs (such as rosemary, thyme, sage, tarragon, oregano, etc)
directions: If you have time, you can marinate the chicken in a mixture of salt and water, maybe some sugar, for an hour or more.
Otherwise, mix the butter, herbs, garlic, and salt and pepper together in a small bowl.

Using your fingers, carefully separate skin from each side of side of the breast and thighs and spread about 1 tablespoon of the herb butter under each area. Season skin with additional salt and pepper to taste. Brush or spray with a little olive oil.

Place chicken skin-side down on a medium-hot, cleaned, and sprayed grill and cook until skin is deeply browned and crisp, about 10 to 15 minutes. For Tuscan style (under a brick), you can press down on this splayed or spatchcocked chicken with bricks wrapped in foil, or bricks in a cast iron frying pan or even a cookie sheet.
Flip chicken over, cover with weights again, and continue to grill until an instant-read thermometer inserted in thickest part of breast registers 160°F, about 10 to 15 minutes more.
Transfer chicken to a cutting board and allow to rest for 10 to 15 minutes. Carve and serve.
